thread:
Marco: Heads up — multiple multi-GPU jobs in apac-gw-2 started failing NCCL timeouts right after yesterday's edge gateway kernel update. Seeing a pattern: east-west traffic to other racks drops intermittently, but control plane stays fine.
Priya: ugh. Symptoms? packet loss counters, MTU errors, or rdma bringup failures?
Marco: px: ncclevents show timeouts + 'Unreachable' from peers. dmesg on hosts shows mlx5 QP timeouts and some 'rdma: device event' logs.
Omar: can you paste `ip link` and `ibv_devinfo` from an affected host?
Marco: pasted: `ip link show eth0 mtu 1500 qlen 1000` but infra inventory says hosts should be 9000. `ifconfig eth0` shows RX errors: 175 in last 5m. `ibv_devinfo` reports port state ERR (port not active) intermittently.
Jenna: That MTU mismatch is suspicious — we had a change on the APAC edge to enable GENEVE offload on the gateway nodes yesterday. VXLAN/Geneve offload + jumbo mismatch can cause packets to be fragmented/back-pressured.
infra-bot: Deploy 0a3b completed on apac-edge-gw-cluster at 2024-11-15T03:12:34Z (kernel 6.2.15 -> 6.2.16).
Omar: Check `ethtool -k eth0` and `ethtool -K eth0 gro off gso off txvlan off` outputs. Offloads can interact poorly with mlx5 offloads for RoCEv2.
Marco: `ethtool -k` shows: rx-gro: on, tx-checksum: on, tx-gso: on, tso: on, hw-tc-offload: on. I ran `ethtool -K eth0 txvlan off`, but still seeing drops.
Priya: Are TORs set to 9000? Could be asymmetric MTU: host 9000 vs gateway 1500 or reverse. Even a single hop with 1500 will cause RoCE packets to be dropped.
Marco: Checked TOR: two leaf switches still set to 9216 on APAC rack 12, but apac-edge-gw nodes report 1500. Looks like the gateway kernel update reset the NIC's MTU during boot due to a netplan change.
Jenna: That would explain it. RoCE needs end-to-end mtu-large or you'll fragment UD/RC packets and QPs start timing out. Can you `ip -s link` and capture `mlx5_core` logs?
Marco: `ip -s link show eth0` shows RX: 1.2M bytes, 243 errors. Kernel: `mlx5_core 0000:65:00.0: mtu set to 1500, previous 9000`. Also saw `mlx5_core: mcg/qp flush due to path migration` entries.
Omar: Two quick actions: 1) schedule rolling restart to set MTU back to 9000 on gateways (netplan fix), 2) disable GENEVE/GRE offloads temporarily to avoid segmentation offload mismatch across kernel versions.
Jenna: Also check if PFC was enabled on those VXLAN/Geneve ports — we had a bug where offloaded tunnels didn't advertise PFC and caused bufferbloat and micro-drop cascades for RoCE.
Marco: Will patch netplan to force `mtu 9000` and push a small daemon that verifies `ip link` at boot. Running `rdma_pingpong` after MTU fix to validate.
ops-sre: Are we able to move critical trains to other regions while you remediate? We have queued jobs in prod.
Marco: We throttled new job scheduling in apac region 20m ago. Some long-running jobs will still be impacted until nodes are reprovisioned.
Priya: For immediate mitigation, for nodes where we can't reboot: try `ethtool -K eth0 gro off gso off tso off` + `sysctl -w net.core.rmem_max=268435456` and restart rdma service. Not perfect but reduces packet coalescing that hides MTU mismatch.
Marco: Applied `ethtool -K` on two hot hosts — `ibv_rc_pingpong` latency returned to normal and NCCL job resumed on one cluster. Running `ib_write_bw` now to confirm throughput.
Omar: Can you collect tcpdump/pcap on the gateway and host for a failing interval? Capture needs `-s 0` and filter UDP dst port for RoCEv2 (4791) and possible VXLAN/GENEVE headers.
Marco: Started tcpdump on gw and host. Saw many `ICMP fragmentation needed` coming from the gateway, which matches MTU mismatch hypothesis.
Jenna: Nice catch. Create a postmortem doc: note the kernel upgrade reset NIC MTU and enabled geneve offload by default. Action items: netplan change, boot verification, and a test playbook to validate RoCE end-to-end after kernel upgrades.
infra-bot: Created ticket INFRA-APAC-8027: "apac-gateway kernel update reset MTU -> RDMA/NCCL impact" assigned to Marco, Priya.
Marco: Plan: 1) immediate: set MTU to 9000 on all apac-edge-gw nodes + disable tunnel offloads (rolling, low blast) 2) medium: netplan / cloud-init fix + boot check 3) long: add canary job that runs rdma_pingpong/nccl-smoke on gateway updates.
ops-sre: Keep me posted. If we see re-occurrence after change, we'll failover traffic to apac-secondary and rollback kernel.
Marco: Will deploy changes in next 30m and update thread with `ibv_devinfo` and NCCL logs. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
Jenna: Also add a note to release checklist: "verify MTU and tunnel offloads after kernel bumps for NICs with mlx5"
Marco: update: after forcing MTU 9000 + disabling geneve offload on 6 hosts, NCCL jobs recovered across the rack. Leaving a 2-hour watch window.
infra-bot: Watch window started at 1769004480 for apac-edge-gw cluster (2 hours).
